Name: Christmas_Shepherd_Feast_Line
$Comment: Bram's Christmas line in his Harvest Feast conversation. Christmas starts while the feast's last days
still run, and while the feast runs Bram speaks his feast conversation
(NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Shepherd_Temple.json takes its feast entry first). This line lets a
player reach his Christmas stall from the first day of Christmas all the same, and its second line
opens his quest list, where his Christmas quests (Reindeer Food, christmas_reindeer_food, and his
daily, Daily Carrots, christmas_daily_carrots, and his apprentice quest, christmas_bram_apprentice)
are offered, carried and handed in, since they are bound to the id he keeps in both seasons
(Harvest_Feast_Shepherd), beside the day's job from his own board
(Boards/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Shepherd_Jobs.json, which Hosts that id). Once the feast is over he speaks
his Christmas conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Shepherd.json), which offers the stall
and the quests itself, and the feast conversation is no longer reached.
Dialogues.Ids names his feast conversation alone, since each villager's lines open that villager's
own stall and quests. They land on the screens the conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines
and before the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. Season offers them only while Christmas runs; to
take them out, set Enabled false in a file of the same name. The lines pay nothing themselves.
